name: Chest-to-Bar Pull-Up
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder width and your core braced.
Depress your shoulder blades and pull explosively upward by driving your elbows down and behind your ribs.
Lean slightly back at the top so your upper chest makes clean contact with the bar.
Lower yourself smoothly under control all the way back to full straight-arm extension.
tips: Drive your elbows down and back aggressively to finish the extra range without craning your neck.
Start every repetition from a full dead hang with your core tight and legs steady.
